description: Automated physician scheduling for residency programs. Our managed service takes your rules and delivers optimized, ACGME-compliant schedules.
h1: Automated Physician Scheduling Without the Software
paragraph: Stop spending weeks learning complex software. Submit your program's rules and let Scheduling Wizard's managed service deliver your optimized, ACGME-compliant schedule.

cta.title: Get Your Physician Schedules Done Right
cta.description: Join the 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices already using Scheduling Wizard for automated physician scheduling. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: Automated physician scheduling uses computational optimization to generate compliant, fair schedules based on a program's specific rules, rather than building them manually in spreadsheets. Scheduling Wizard takes this further as a fully managed service: programs submit their rules, and our team produces finished Block, Call, Clinic, and Attending schedules delivered as Excel files. No scheduling software is required on the program's end.
faq.question: What is automated physician scheduling and how does it work?

faq.answer: Yes. ACGME duty hour compliance is built into the schedule as it is built, not reviewed manually afterward. Our team enforces the 80-hour weekly limit, 10-hour rest minimums, the 24-hour hard cap, and subspecialty-specific rules built into the system. This means the rules are applied before the schedule reaches your program, rather than detected and corrected post-hoc.
faq.question: Is Scheduling Wizard's automated scheduling ACGME compliant?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard operates as a done-for-you managed service, meaning the optimization is handled by Scheduling Wizard's schedulers. Chief residents and program coordinators do not need to learn or operate any scheduling software. Programs provide their rules and requirements, and Scheduling Wizard delivers the finished, ready-to-publish schedule.
faq.question: Who handles the scheduling process at Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: When unplanned changes occur, such as sick leave, parental leave, or resident swaps, Scheduling Wizard can re-optimize the affected portions of the schedule without reshuffling the entire year. Rule configurations are retained, so mid-year revisions process against the same rules that governed the original schedule.
faq.question: How does automated scheduling handle mid-year changes or resident absences?

faq.answer: Yes. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have for day-to-day schedule access. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule creation and optimization, delivering finished Excel files that programs can upload directly to their existing viewing platform. The two tools serve different parts of the scheduling workflow.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates four schedule types: Block and rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules coordinated against rotation and call obligations, and Attending schedules aligned with resident assignments. All four are optimized simultaneously using the same set of rules, so changes in one schedule type automatically propagate across the others.
